title: Preserve comparison values in diff flame graph sandwich transforms
answers: Why do Sandwich view tooltips show NaN or undefined in a diff flame graph?
How should Callers/Callees merges preserve comparison values?
How should diff tooltips handle a missing valueRight?
body:
Symptom: In a Diff flame graph's Sandwich view (Callers/Callees), Baseline/Comparison/Diff tooltip values display NaN% or undefined.
Root cause: packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:mergeSubtrees and packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:getParentSubtrees rebuilt value without preserving valueRight; packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/FlameGraphTooltip.tsx:getDiffTooltipData assumed item.valueRight existed.
Fix pattern: Merge valueRight alongside value using transformed input values, counting missing valueRight as zero when any input carries it; when rebasing parents, copy both values from the child. Normalize missing tooltip item.valueRight to zero before arithmetic and formatting.
Constraints: Comparison-value aggregation applies when at least one merged input has valueRight; non-diff merges must leave valueRight undefined. The tooltip fallback is defensive; accurate comparison values still require the transforms to preserve them.
applies: Diff flame graph node merging, Sandwich view parent rebasing, and tooltip calculations involving item.valueRight.
